{"rule_yaml": "title: PowerShell Execution via Outlook
id: 4f2a1b3c-5d6e-7f8a-9b0c-1d2e3f4a5b6c
status: experimental
description: Detects PowerShell execution launched by Outlook with common evasion flags (Bypass, Hidden).
logsource:
    product: windows
    category: process_creation
detection:
    selection:
        ParentImage|endswith: '\OUTLOOK.EXE'
        Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
        CommandLine|contains:
            - '-ExecutionPolicy Bypass'
            - '-WindowStyle Hidden'
    condition: selection
fields:
    - ComputerName
    - User
    - CommandLine
    - ParentImage
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate Outlook add-ins or administrative scripts launched via Outlook (rare).
level: high
tags:
    - attack.execution
    - attack.t1059.001
"}

{"rule_text": "rule PowerShell_Malware_Facture {
    meta:
        description = "Detects the malicious PowerShell script facture_2024-11.ps1 based on AMSI bypass and keylogging signatures"
        author = "SOC Analyst"
        date = "2024-11-16"
        reference = "C8, C10"

    strings:
        $amsi_bypass = "amsiInitFailed" nocase
        $keylog_api = "GetAsyncKeyState" nocase
        $keylog_api2 = "ToUnicode" nocase
        $exfil_url = "http://192.168.1.100:8080/beacon" nocase
        $sandbox_check = "sandboxIndicators" nocase

    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0 || (all of ($amsi_bypass, $keylog_api, $keylog_api2) and 1 of ($exfil_url, $sandbox_check))
}"}
